Duplicate Properties on Shikinai Ronsha

Due to a partial data migration that broke provenance, many Shikinai Ronsha items ended up with duplicate P361, P1448, and P6375 statements. The original source had bad data modelling, and correcting it in a way that broke provenance made the situation worse.

Counts queried at 2026-07-09 16:54 UTC. Nothing drains these automatically, so a count only moves when someone fixes an item by hand — a number that looks stuck is a backlog, not a stale page.

P361 (part of) — 383 items with duplicates

The ordinals and the follows / followed-by qualifiers are already resolved on the Shikinaisha list entry items; they are not resolved here. Where one Ronsha item absorbed several list entries, their statements collapsed together and the neighbours cross-contaminated — 55 of these carry a statement with more than one P155/P156 value (highlighted). Those are what the migration has to rebuild from the entry items.
